caption: The drawing consists of a square composition with a dark blue background and white geometric patterns. In the center, there is a grid of 5 by 5 alternating white and blue squares, forming a checkerboard pattern. Surrounding the central checkerboard, at the four corners of the square, are larger white outlined squares, each with a smaller blue square inside and small white dots at the corners of the outlines. On each side of the square, between the corner squares, there are pairs of vertical white rectangles. The edges of the square feature repeating white lines and right-angle shapes. The bottom area of the blue field contains two horizontal rows with elongated oval and rectangular shapes connected by white dotted lines, mirroring each other around the horizontal axis. The entire arrangement is framed by a thin black double-lined border on an off-white background. Handwritten text appears at the lower edge of the drawing, with “A3285. A.” on the left and “Putnam Barnes” on the right.
title: Coverlet (Section)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
